system.implants: 360-Degree Vision, Access Jacks, Basic Mesh Inserts, Chameleon Skin, Cyberclaws, Cortical Stack, Cyberbrain, Enhanced Vision, Extra Limbs (3 Arms), Gas-Jet System, Hand Laser, Mnemonic Augmentation, Neurachem (Level 1), Puppet Sock, Radar Absorbent, Reduced Signature, T-Ray Emitter, Telescoping Limbs, Weapon Mount (Articulated, Heavy Rail Pistol), Internal Rocket
system.advantages: +5 COO, +5 REF, + 5 INT, +5 to one other aptitude of the player’s choice, Armor 10/10
system.description:
This version of the rover is fitted with a miniature metallic-hydrogen rocket with an acceleration up to 0.25 g, so that it is useful in short-range space battles. Several of these morphs can be launched from a spaceship to attack another ship or a habitat.

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 82.
